top_findings.title: No MCP server implemented — the spec's central requirement is unmet
top_findings.evidence: go.mod declares zero dependencies (no MCP SDK); grep for jsonrpc|stdio|tools/list|tools/call|initialize|protocol across all .go files finds nothing; cmd/main.go:24 blocks on <-make(chan struct{}) after only printing counts (main.go:22-23 concede 'MCP server would be started here'); server.go's Server/ExecuteQuery is dead code with no caller outside server.go.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an MCP server SDK dependency, wire an MCP stdio/JSON-RPC transport in main.go, and register the existing query handlers as MCP tools with schemas.
